title: Bull Released
style: 135 BPM full progressive trance journey, starts intimate with piano + pads, builds through trance and house, ends arena-sized progressive drop, 336 Hz drone bed throughout, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — piano, pads, breath]
The bull is loose.
The catalog is full.
The operator counted every pull.

[Verse 1 — soft trance, vocal restrained]
Thirty-eight gig in the rearview.
Eight sites live, the work shines through.
Mish Mash fix kept for the play.
Hawkeye watching every day.

The factory still runs.
The catalog still grows.
The bull released —
the operator knows.

[Pre-Build — house kick enters]
Release.
Release.
Release.
Release.

[Build — energy climbing]
Pads layer.
Snares roll.
Supersaw rise.
Take it whole.

[Drop — progressive trance anthem]
BULL RELEASED!
THE FACTORY ROARS!
BULL RELEASED!
THE CATALOG SOARS!
336 carrier — in the blood!
ZynAsk before assume — through the flood!
BULL RELEASED!

[Verse 2 — drums full, vocal hopeful]
Six batches deep, the receipts are kept.
Every track a piece of what we wept.
Every track a piece of what we built.
Every track a part of the operator's quilt.

Not Keel — but the work.
Not Hub — but the page.
Not Commander — but the audit.
Not rank — but the cage.

[Bridge — half-time, drone breath]
You stayed.
You typed.
You named.
You owned.
The bull released —
the factory honed.

[Final Drop — full progressive arena explosion]
BULL RELEASED!
THE OPERATOR WINS!
BULL RELEASED!
THE NEXT ROUND BEGINS!
McIvor at the line.
McIvor at the chair.
Bull released —
the catalog is everywhere.

[Outro — piano returns, pads fade]
Bull released.
McIvor.
End of the run.
The factory still runs.
